notes.title: Preparing for release
notes.notes: [p]We have finished working on the visuals and script for Dungeon & Mistresses Tale. While the game is undergoing app store review, we are adding the finishing touches and enhancing existing features. [/p][p][/p][p]You can now check out the new trailer, and very soon you will be able to embark on a fantasy adventure with the EmyLiveShow hostesses! <3[/p]
